items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: now there was another fellow by the name of Jimmy Strode from here too. He worked out of the stockyard, was lugging that beef, and he caught TB and he died.

ctx.x: And he would get the rooster crow or anything like that?

Yeah, yeah, rooster and all that stuff. Yeah. Eccentric was one of the principal tunes I'd say. And he really could get the effect. Well Freddie, he played open a lot. And it was a difference of, now there was another fellow by the name of Jimmy Strode from here too. He worked out of the stockyard, was lugging that beef, and he caught TB and he died. And then we had a fellow named, see what it was? Jimmy who?
